sonuc.drug_name: Nexium Control 20 mg gastro-resistant tablets / hard capsules

what_for.text: It treats short-term reflux symptoms like heartburn and acid regurgitation in adults.
what_for.evidence: This medicine is used in adults for the short-term treatment of reflux symptoms (for example, heartburn and acid regurgitation).

how_to_use.text: Take one tablet or capsule a day. Do not take more.
how_to_use.evidence: The recommended dose is one tablet a day. ... Do not take more than this recommended dose of one tablet (20 mg) a day

how_to_use.text: Swallow your tablet whole with half a glass of water.
how_to_use.evidence: Swallow your tablet whole with half a glass of water. Do not chew or crush the tablet.

how_to_use.text: You can take it at any time, with or without food.
how_to_use.evidence: You can take your tablet at any time of the day either with food or on an empty stomach.

how_to_use.text: If you forget a dose, take it as soon as you remember on the same day.
how_to_use.evidence: If you forget to take a dose, take it as soon as you remember it, on the same day.

how_to_use.text: Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.
how_to_use.evidence: Do not take a double dose to make up for a forgotten dose.

see_doctor_now.text: Get urgent medical care if you get chest pain with dizziness, sweating, or shortness of breath.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Seek urgent medical attention if you experience chest pain with light-headedness, sweating, dizziness or shoulder pain with shortness of breath.

see_doctor_now.text: Stop taking and see a doctor immediately if you notice sudden wheezing or throat swelling.
see_doctor_now.evidence: stop taking Nexium Control and contact a doctor immediately: ... Sudden wheezing, swelling of your lips, tongue and throat, rash, fainting or difficulties in swallowing

see_doctor_now.text: Stop taking and call a doctor immediately if your skin blisters or peels.
see_doctor_now.evidence: stop taking Nexium Control and contact a doctor immediately: ... Reddening of the skin with blisters or peeling.

see_doctor_now.text: Stop taking and contact a doctor immediately if you notice yellow skin and dark urine.
see_doctor_now.evidence: stop taking Nexium Control and contact a doctor immediately: ... Yellow skin, dark urine and tiredness, which can be symptoms of liver problems, seen rarely.

see_doctor_now.text: Tell your doctor immediately if you lose weight for no reason or vomit blood.
see_doctor_now.evidence: Tell your doctor immediately before or after taking this medicine, if you notice any of the following symptoms ... You lose a lot of weight for no reason. ... You begin to vomit food or blood

side_effects.text: Common side effects include headache, stomach pain, diarrhoea, constipation, wind, and nausea.
side_effects.evidence: Common (may affect up to 1 in 10 people) ... Headache. ... Effects on your stomach or gut: diarrhoea, stomach ache, constipation, wind (flatulence). ... Feeling sick (nausea) or being sick (vomiting).

side_effects.text: Uncommon side effects include swelling of feet, sleep problems, dizziness, and dry mouth.
side_effects.evidence: Uncommon (may affect up to 1 in 100 people) ... Swelling of the feet and ankles. ... Disturbed sleep (insomnia), feeling sleepy. ... Dizziness, tingling feelings such as “pins and needles”. ... Dry mouth.

storage.text: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine out of the sight and reach of children.

storage.text: Keep it in the original package to protect from moisture.
storage.evidence: Keep this medicine in the original package in order to protect from moisture.
